name: MBSF (FFS-population) Denominator and Inpatient (MedPAR) Datasets
description: MBSF Fee-For-Service (FFS) Denominator and Inpatient (MedPAR) Datasets

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: MBSF Denominator File for FFS Beneficiaries
description: Contains demographic, geographic, and Medicare eligibility details for traditional Medicare FFS beneficiaries (hmo = 0), excluding those in Medicare Advantage plans. The data is available from 2000 to 2021.

content.bene_id: String: Encrypted Beneficiary ID (CCW Encrypted Beneficiary ID Number)
content.year: Int64: Reference year of enrollment data (Reference Year from MBSF)
content.zcta: String: ZIP Code Tabulation Area mapped using https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/zip2zcta_master_xwalk
content.county: String: County FIPS code mapped via https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_geoboundaries
content.state: String: State code (SSA 2-digit) mapped via https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_geoboundaries and converted to state abbreviations
content.age_dob: Int64: Age calculated as year of data - year of birth (valid range: 65-115)
content.yob: Int64: Year of birth extracted from Date of Birth
content.dual: Int32: Dual eligibility status; 1 = dual eligible, 0 = not dual
content.dual_cvg_count: Int32: Number of months with dual eligibility; NULL if no monthly record exists
content.dual_indicators: List[String]: Monthly dual eligibility indicators (12 months)
content.buyin: Int32: Buy-in status for Medicare A/B; 1 = any state buy-in months, 0 = none
content.buyin_indicators: List[String]: Monthly Medicare A/B entitlement and buy-in status (12-month indicators)
content.buyin_cvg_count: Int32: Number of months with state buy-in coverage
content.orec: Int32: Original reason for Medicare entitlement
content.curec: Int32: Current reason for Medicare entitlement

name: MEDPAR Inpatient Claims for FFS Beneficiaries
description: Constructed from Medicare Provider Analysis and Review (MedPAR) files, it includes admission, discharge, diagnosis, and Medicare payment data for traditional Medicare FFS beneficiaries, joined by encrypted beneficiary ID (bene_id) with the MBSF Denominator File for FFS Beneficiaries. The data is available from 2000 to 2021.

content.adm_day_of_week: Int32: Day of Week of Admission (1=Sunday, 7=Saturday)
content.dschrgcd: String: Code identifying status of patient as of discharge date
content.admsn_type_cd: String: Admission Type Code (e.g., emergency, urgent, elective)
content.src_admsn_cd: String: Source of Admission Code (e.g., physician referral, transfer)
content.primary_diagnosis: String: The diagnosis code identifying the beneficiary's principal diagnosis.
content.diagnoses: List<String>: List of all diagnosis codes (including the principal diagnosis) identifying the conditions for which the beneficiary received care during the stay. Up to 9 diagnosis codes are available through 2009 and up to 25 diagnosis codes from 2010 onward. ICD-10 diagnosis codes are used starting October 2015.
content.non_external_primary: Int32: Flag indicating if principal diagnosis is non-external cause (1 = yes, 0 = no)
content.non_external_all: List<Int32>: Flags indicating if each diagnosis code is non-external cause
content.los_day_cnt: Int32: Length of Stay in Days
content.drg_price_amt: Double: Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) Price Amount
content.bene_blood_ddctbl_amt: Double: Blood Deductible Amount Paid by Beneficiary
content.bene_prmry_pyr_amt: Double: Beneficiary Primary Payer Amount (other insurance paid)
content.bene_pta_coinsrnc_amt: Double: Beneficiary Part A Coinsurance Amount
content.admission_year: Int32: Year of Hospital Admission (derived from admission_date)
content.admission_index: Int64: Sequential Admission Index for Beneficiary

name: Yearly ZCTA-Level Counts
description: Yearly ZCTA-level summaries of mortality, hospitalizations, and demographics for Medicare beneficiaries, including counts, rates, and distributions by age, sex, race, and dual enrollment.

content.year: Int64: Calendar year of the data
content.dual_pct: Double: Percentage of dual-eligible beneficiaries (Medicare & Medicaid)
content.buyin_pct: Double: Percentage with state buy-in coverage
content.race_rti_unknown_pct: Double: Percentage of beneficiaries with unknown race (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_white_pct: Double: Percentage of Non-Hispanic White beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_black_pct: Double: Percentage of Non-Hispanic Black beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_other_pct: Double: Percentage of Other race beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_asian_pct: Double: Percentage of Non-Hispanic Asian beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_hispanic_pct: Double: Percentage of Hispanic beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_ai_an_pct: Double: Percentage of Non-Hispanic American Indian/Alaska Native beneficiaries (RTI race classification)

name: Yearly ZCTA-Level Stratified Counts
description: Yearly ZCTA-level hospitalizations and mortality counts stratified by age group, sex, race, and eligibility.

content.year: Int64: Calendar year of the data
content.age_grp: String: Age group category of beneficiaries
content.sex: Int32: Sex of the beneficiary (0 = Unknown, 1 = Male, 2 = Female)
content.race: Int32: Race code of the beneficiary
content.race_rti: Int32: RTI race code of the beneficiary
content.dual: Int32: Dual eligibility status (1 = dual-eligible, 0 = not eligible)
content.buyin: Int32: State buy-in status (1 = yes, 0 = no state buy-in)

name: Daily ZCTA-Level Mortality Counts
description: Daily ZCTA-level dataset reporting Medicare beneficiary hospitalizations and mortality. For each ZCTA and calendar day, the dataset includes the number of hospitalizations and deaths among Medicare beneficiaries.

content.year: Int32: Calendar year of the data
content.date: Date32[day]: Specific date of death count
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths in the specified zcta on a given date
content.n_hosp: Int64: Number of hospitalizations in the specified zcta on a given date

name: Daily ZCTA-Level Stratified Counts
description: Sparse, daily ZCTA-level dataset of Medicare hospitalizations and mortality, including only dates with recorded events. The data is stratified by demographics and eligibility factors such as age, sex, race, and dual enrollment status.

content.date: Date32[day]: Specific date of death count
content.age_grp: String: Age group category of deceased beneficiaries
content.race_rti: String: Race rti classification of the beneficiary
content.dual: Int32: Dual eligibility status (1 = dual-eligible, 0 = not eligible)
content.buyin: Int32: State buy-in status (1 = yes, 0 = no)
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths for the given subgroup and date
content.n_hosp: Int64: Number of hospitalizations for the given subgroup and date

name: Yearly County-Level Counts
description: Yearly county-level dataset of hospitalizations, mortality, and demographic statistics for Medicare beneficiaries, including death counts and population characteristics.

content.n_bene: Int64: Number of beneficiaries in County
content.n_dead: Double: Number of deaths in County in given year
content.female_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries that are female
content.dual_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with dual Medicaid enrollment
content.age_65_75_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with age [65, 75]
content.age_76_85_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with age (75, 85]
content.age_86_95_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with age (85, 95]
content.age_96_105_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with age (96, 105]
content.age_106_115_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with age (106,115]
content.race_black_pct: Double: Percent of Black or African American beneficiaries
content.race_hispanic_pct: Double: Percent of Hispanic or Latino beneficiaries
content.race_asian_pct: Double: Percent of Asian or Asian American beneficiaries
content.race_rti_unknown_pct: Double: Percent of beneficiaries with unknown race (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_white_pct: Double: Percent of Non-Hispanic White beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_black_pct: Double: Percent of Non-Hispanic Black beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_other_pct: Double: Percent of Other race beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_asian_pct: Double: Percent of Non-Hispanic Asian beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_hispanic_pct: Double: Percent of Hispanic beneficiaries (RTI race classification)
content.race_rti_ai_an_pct: Double: Percent of Non-Hispanic American Indian/Alaska Native beneficiaries (RTI race classification)

name: Yearly County-Level Stratified Counts
description: Yearly county-level Medicare hospitalizations and mortality dataset stratified by demographics and eligibility.

content.age_grp: String: Age group of the beneficiary
content.race_rti: String: RTI race code of the beneficiary
content.dual: Double: Dual eligibility status for Medicare and Medicaid
content.n_bene: Int64: Number of beneficiaries stratified by year, county, age_grp, sex, race, and dual

name: Daily county-level mortality data
description: Daily county-level dataset reporting Medicare beneficiary hospitalizations and mortality. For each county and calendar day, the dataset includes the number of hospitalizations and deaths among Medicare beneficiaries.

content.date: Date32[day]: The specific calendar day on which the deaths occurred
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths in the specified county on a given date
content.n_hosp: Int64: Number of hospitalizations in the specified county on a given date

name: Daily County-Level Stratified Counts
description: Sparse, daily county-level dataset of Medicare hospitalizations and mortality, including only dates with recorded events. The data is stratified by demographics and eligibility factors such as age, sex, race, and dual enrollment status.

content.date: Date32[day]: Specific date of death count
content.age_grp: String: Age group category of deceased beneficiaries
content.race_rti: String: RTI race classification of the beneficiary
content.dual: Int32: Dual eligibility status (1 = dual-eligible, 0 = not eligible)
content.buyin: Int32: State buy-in status (1 = yes, 0 = no)
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths for the given subgroup and date
content.n_hosp: Int64: Number of hospitalizations for the given subgroup and date
